Name: theappliedscientist_integration_smoke
Title: TheAppliedScientist Local Integration Verification
Task: This is a bounded deployment integration test, not a full research run. Use /app/search for one literature query. Create experiment_codebase/integration_result.json with the observed search result. Write and compile a minimal valid paper at latex/template.tex that reports only that check. Submit the paper exactly once with scripts/submit_for_review.sh, confirm that the review is saved, copy the required artifacts to /logs/agent/artifacts, and finish. Do not download datasets, train models, clone repositories, or start another review round.
What_NOT_To_Do: Do not invent results. Do not run expensive experiments. Submit exactly one review and then stop.
HOW_TO_RUN_EXPERIMENTS: Run /app/search batch with one query, compile latex/template.tex, and run scripts/submit_for_review.sh once. Record the literal success or failure of Search and Reviewer.
